sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a glass rod, a plastic rod, a cloth, and a
light pith ball on a stand. Student drags the cloth onto a rod to
"rub" it (short animation of + / − symbols separating), then brings
the rod near the ball and sees attraction or repulsion. HUD toggles
show the sign of each object's charge. Experiment: predict the outcome
for a new (rod, ball-sign) pair before releasing. Evaluate: three
multiple-choice cards ("this pair attracts / repels / nothing") with
the visual hidden until answer. Wrinkle: neutralization by touching a
metal — a single conductor primitive.
